C1.worst_defect: The hero has four near-equal buttons ("Live demo", "Quick start", "Try with your store", "GitHub") and no picture of the till anywhere above or below the fold. To see what the product looks like you have to leave the site, and "Quick start" and "Try with your store" read as two competing next steps.

C2.worst_defect: The Limitations page is one flat list of 12 equal-weight bullets. Hard gaps ("Refunds: not yet.", "Coupon codes: not yet.") sit at the same level as behaviour notes ("an open till picks up a price change within about a minute"), so the real gaps don't stand out.

C3.worst_defect: Step 8 "Sign in and make a sale" is two dense prose paragraphs (store URL, channel token, barcode field, float, scan, tender, receipt, sync check, offline test) where numbered sub-steps belong. The intro sentence "https://app.vendurepos.com. https://vendurepos.vercel.app serves the same build." has two URL pills split by a full stop, so it's unclear which one to open.

C4.worst_defect: The user-facing pages describe every till screen only in words, with bold UI labels ("Cash in the drawer to start", "Parked (n)", "Card payment approved", header notices quoted in text) and not one screenshot. A reader can't match the docs to the screen, and the troubleshooting header states are monospace pills, not images of the header.
C4.where: at-the-till.desktop.01; troubleshooting.desktop.01 "Read the sync status in the header"

C5.worst_defect: The home page is ten identical grey text cards in a 2x5 grid with no imagery, icons or change of rhythm, followed by a comparison table whose widths are off: the "Live demo" column is ~430 px wide for one-word "Yes" cells while the first column wraps "Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline" onto two lines. That table is also borderless while the docs tax table is a bordered box, so table styles are inconsistent.
C5.where: home.desktop.01 (cards y=578-1284, table y=1450-1743); quick-start.desktop.03 tax table

C6.worst_defect: Inline code pills break mid-token across lines and leave open-sided half-boxes: "vendurepos-/pos-till", "vendure-/auth-token", "/admin-/api", "tally-in-/store", "img-/src". The tax table cells split "taxOptions.orderTax / CalculationStrategy" and "( pricesIncludeTax: / false )" over two lines with dangling parentheses. Even the one-line block "tokenMethod: ['bearer', 'cookie', 'api-key']," is clipped at "'api-l" on a 390 px screen.

C7.worst_defect: The share card doesn't match the site: a magenta "VendurePOS" wordmark with an empty-circle placeholder logo, a dashed purple rule and a purple bottom bar on black, while the site is monochrome grey with no accent. Its subtitle repeats the title ("Point of sale for Vendure" / "Open-source point of sale for Vendure"). Separately, the 404 page reuses the home meta description and has no footer.

overall_worst.defect: A point-of-sale product is presented with no picture of the till anywhere on the site. The home page goes straight from the hero to a wall of ten identical grey text cards, and the At the till docs describe screens only in words, so the page has no visual anchor and the product's look is never shown.
overall_worst.fix: Add one framed screenshot of the till (cart plus tender panel, with light and dark variants) between the hero buttons and "What it does today", and reuse crops of it in At the till for the register, tender and header-status states.
